claims: No. 1 seed UConn defeated No. 16 seed UTSA 90-52 in the 2026 NCAA Women’s Tournament first round on March 21, 2026.
Sarah Strong led UConn with 18 points and five steals.
Ashlynn Shade scored 14 points for UConn.
The victory was UConn's 51st consecutive victory.
Ereauna Hardaway scored 11 points for UTSA.
Cheyenne Rowe scored 11 points for UTSA.
Damara Allen scored 11 points for UTSA.
The game was at Gampel Pavilion, Storrs, Conn.
Blanca Quinonez scored 10 points for UConn.
UConn advances to face the winner of Syracuse vs. Iowa State.
UConn held UTSA to under 30 rebounds
